exposure: Implementation of a simulator-based training program for external cephalic version
outcome: Success rate of external cephalic version
Complication rates of external cephalic version
cohort: The study involved 170 external cephalic version procedures performed on pregnant individuals by a dedicated team at a tertiary care university center over two two-year periods.
finding: A structured simulation-based training program for external cephalic version did not significantly impact the success rate or the complication rates of the procedure.
